meta.title: Cross-border
meta.description: Cross-border e-commerce workbench: products with landed cost in CNY, listings per platform and market with commission, VAT, ads and returns, live profit and margin in the sale currency (daily ECB rates), a price calculator for a target margin, and inbound shipments that restock on delivery. The agent can research prices and write listings. No store API is connected; data is entered by hand or by the agent.
